usage.finalMessage:
I added `fee-preview <invoice>`, which shows the late fee at the 1.5% rate in DEC-B08 (the rule in force) without charging anything, and listed it in `help` after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 7 of 7, including one test I added, and the work is committed.
Problem for Finance: `run-late-fees` still charges the old 2% rate from DEC-B03, which DEC-B08 replaced. So a preview can show a lower fee than the one actually charged. I didn't change `run-late-fees` because BILL-31 doesn't cover it and an existing test expects 2%. This and two smaller questions are recorded in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
